name: Scream

abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Vicious: Hasar veren debuff'ların gücünü belirtilen miktarda artırır.
abilityDetails.Energize: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Impact: Blok Nüfuzunu (Block Penetration) belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Undermine: Aktifken saldırılar Otomatik Blok ile engellenemez.
abilityDetails.Auto-Block: Şampiyonun kombo alırken bile otomatik olarak siper/blok yapmasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Infuriate: Rakip daha saldırgan hale gelir ve saldırı yetenek doğruluğu azalır.
abilityDetails.Fervor: Giden hasar veren etkilerin yetenek doğruluğunu artırır.
abilityDetails.Direct Damage: Zırh ve dirençleri yok sayan doğrudan hasar verir.

signatureAbility:
Bad Hair Day
When Madness is consumed by Scream, [35 - 75.2]% chance to gain a Regeneration Buff healing 3% of missing Health over 5 seconds.
Against #Spider-Verse Heroes, each stack of Madness reduces the Opponent's Evade Ability Accuracy by [12.5 - 25]%.
Against #Symbiotes when gaining Madness, each stack of Madness grants a [12.5 - 25]% chance to gain 1 extra Madness.
Against Tech Champions, each stack of Madness reduces the Opponent's Armor Up Ability Accuracy by [12.5 - 25]%.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks - Rip and Hair
content: All hits have a 25% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff dealing [1,642.5] Direct Damage over 10 seconds.

When the Opponent is inflicted with a personal Bleed, also inflict a [144.74] Armor Break Debuff for 10 seconds, plus 0.5 seconds for each rank invested in the Deep Wounds Mastery. If a personal Bleed is prevented by an Immunity, inflict 2 Armor Breaks.

abilitySections.title: Madness Passives - Max: 8
content: Enter each fight with 4 Madness Passives. When these expire naturally, or on Scream's fourth Light Attack, they are all refreshed and 2 Madness are gained.
The first Madness lasts 18 seconds, with each additional Madness increasing their own expiry rate by 20%.
Madness is paused for 0.5 seconds when the Opponent is struck by a Basic Attack and is paused indefinitely during the Opponent's Special Attacks or while Strikers are active.
At 6 or more Madness, the Opponent's Stun Debuffs suffer 100% reduced Ability Accuracy.
When knocked down by a Special Attack, when a personal Buff is Nullified, or when Incinerated by a Mystic Champion, Scream loses 2 Madness. If Madness falls to 0, 1 is gained after 9 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Hybrid Buffs - Max: 2 of Each
content: When Madness is refreshed its icon changes to reflect the currently selected Hybrid Buff, cycling through Scream's indefinite Hybrid Buffs in the order listed below:
A 25% Vicious Buff, a 20% Energize Buff, a [916.67] Bulwark Buff, and a [916.67] Impact Buff.
Hybrid Buffs can only be gained while Madness is at 1 or more. Either Champion's second Medium Attack grants Scream the currently selected Hybrid Buff.
When gaining a Hybrid Buff with 2 of the currently selected Hybrid Buff, Madness is refreshed instead.

While at 2 stacks of any Hybrid Buff, when Scream would gain a Hybrid Buff she also gains a non-stacking Undermine Buff for 5 seconds. As an Attacker, this Undermine is paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Auto-Blocks - Symbiote Sense
content: When Madness is consumed by Scream, gain a non-stacking Auto-Block Buff for 5 seconds that is removed when Auto-Blocking a contact attack.
This Auto-Block Buff grants a 100% chance to Auto-Block Basic Attacks. These count as Well-Timed Blocks and have a 100% chance to resist a Block Break by a Heavy Attack.
When successfully Auto-Blocking an attack, gain 1 of the currently selected Hybrid Buff and inflict a personal Bleed.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks - Consuming Madness
content: Charging a Heavy Attack consumes 1 Madness to inflict a 30% Infuriate Debuff for 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks - Knotted and Broken
content: During Scream's Special Attacks, all personal Debuffs on the Opponent and all personal Buffs other than Regeneration on Scream are paused.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain +[2,190] Attack Rating for each unique Buff on Scream for the duration of this attack.
Each hit consumes 1 Madness to grant Scream a 100% Fervor Buff for 20 seconds. On any hit with 0 Madness, gain 1 Madness and then gain Madness instead of Fervor for the rest of this attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, consume all Madness. If 4 or more Madness were consumed, gain an Unblockable Buff for the duration of this attack.

On each of the final four hits, deal a burst of [1,642.5] Direct Damage for each personal Debuff on the Opponent. The potency of these bursts increases by 8% for each Madness consumed during this attack. Max Debuffs: 30.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain up to 8 Madness, and up to 2 of each Hybrid Buff. Then, until the end of Scream's next Special Attack, abilities that consume Madness during Special Attacks consume 0 but still grant their outlined effects.
